name: Taylor-Green vortex
blurb: An array of counter-rotating vortices in a viscous liquid at Mach 0.1. In 2D the array keeps its shape and its kinetic energy decays as exp(-4 ν k² t), an exact solution of the incompressible equations; in 3D it breaks down into turbulence.

featured.label: Sound speed
featured.tip: The liquid's sound speed. The flow's speed is 1, so the Mach number is 1 over this: at 10 the density stays within 1% of its reference and the flow is incompressible to that accuracy. The step shrinks in proportion as it grows

featured.label: Viscosity
featured.tip: Kinematic viscosity: the Reynolds number is 1 over 2π times this (the vortices are a box wide and turn at speed 1). In 2D the kinetic energy decays at the rate 4 ν k², k = 2π
